messages:
maria: Heads up — experimenting with a compact 'mini-session' snapshot in Console for quick per-route/per-model compare. Idea: ephemeral saved view pinned to header, TTL ~2h, optionally promotable to a full saved query. Thoughts?

jonathan: Love the idea. Key questions: do ephemeral views count against saved-query quotas? And how do we surface telemetry for them?

suresh: My vote: don't count them against saved-query quota unless the user promotes. Telemetry: tag events with session_id + ephemeral=true and sample low by default. We already emit per-route and per-model tags so add session_id.

alicia: UX concern re: routing policies — if a mini-session pins a model variant, should that lock routing (i.e. force variant selection) or let smart-routing override? UX needs to show the interaction.

ben: API debate: current POST /routes/{id}/views uses 'scope' enum (route/org/private). We could add 'ephemeral' as a scope or model it with ttl_seconds optional. Example payload suggestion: {"name":"mini", "filters": [...], "scope":"ephemeral", "ttl_seconds": 7200}.

maria: If we add ephemeral scope, we must ensure usage metrics/billing ignore it until promoted. Also the cost-preview UI should ignore ephemeral views — add ephemeral:true telemetry so UI filters them out.

suresh: Implementation note: telemetry pipeline needs a boolean ephemeral flag. Downstream billing infra might prefer a 'save_type' enum ('ephemeral'|'saved') rather than a new boolean, to avoid ambiguity.

jonathan: Rollouts UX: when an ephemeral binds to a model variant, show a small banner: 'Using pinned variant vX (ephemeral)'. If fallback occurs because of capacity, show 'fallback in effect' and record fallback telemetry with original session_id so we can correlate.

alicia: Edge case: user pins a quantized/dedicated-only variant from Hosted Console and then tries to promote — promote should fail gracefully (403/incompatible) and show clear next steps (request Dedicated trial or pick compatible variant).

ben: Concrete backend API patch proposal:
````
POST /routes/{id}/views
body: { name, filters, scope: 'ephemeral'|'route'|'org', ttl_seconds }
response: { view_id, expires_at }
````
This keeps it fairly small. Older clients will 400 on unknown scope so we need migration notes.

maria: UI notes — ephemeral views go into a 'Transient' section in the views dropdown, sorted by last-used. Keyboard shortcut 'v' to create ephemeral from current route. Promote action in the menu 'Promote to Saved Query' which triggers quota check and promote flow.

jonathan: Telemetry sampling: sample ephemeral events heavier for the first 5m after creation to get UX signals, then back off. Add fields: session_id, ephemeral, initial_high_sample=true so downstream can be smarter.

suresh: Agreed. We'll add 'initial_high_sample' for the pipeline and then flip to sampled=false after the warm window. Also include pinned_variant_id in events when relevant.

alicia: Permissions: ephemeral views created in org-scoped routes should inherit creator's visibility. They should not be shareable until promoted. Also clarify audit logging for promote action.

ben: Backwards compat: if we ship 'scope=ephemeral' and older servers don't know it, they might 400. Migration plan: feature-flag the API, accept unknown scope with a clear 501 message? Or release server-side only and roll clients after.

maria: Plan: write a short RFC outlining: API contract change (ephemeral scope + ttl_seconds), telemetry flagging, UI prototype, backend feature flag, promote flow and quota semantics. Prototype UI next week; I'll open an RFC and link INF ticket.

deploy-bot: created task INF-752: ephemeral-views-prototype

ben: +1 to RFC. I'll sketch the API swagger diff and add migration notes.

jonathan: Also add a quick E2E test that promotes an ephemeral view and verifies quota decrement and telemetry emission for the promote event.

suresh: I'll add telemetry acceptance tests (session id present, ephemeral flag, initial_high_sample toggles).

alicia: UX question left: should ephemeral be default for 'quick save' keyboard? Maybe ask PMs in next sync.

maria: Good call — I'll add it to the RFC for PM feedback. Thanks everyone!
